subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 for reply metadata and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for fallback delivery?
rationale: Current main is partial, and the remaining behavior defines protocol/runtime/session semantics rather than a narrow implementation cleanup.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a successor for structured reply metadata and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 own final fallback delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after confirming the reply metadata and no-output portions are fully tracked by narrower canonical issues or PRs.

options.title: Treat Markdown Reply As Sufficient
options.body: Close as solved by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92654, accepting Markdown quote text instead of structured reply identity and leaving no-output semantics elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a successor for structured reply metadata and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 own final fallback delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses gateway protocol, Control UI, and agent runtime context boundaries where recent history and repository policy point to contract-level ownership.
